The suction chamber control volume solves the transient mass and energy balances, accounting for heat losses to the compressor shell [81]. The single- speed scroll compressor was modeled using a manufacturer-specified AHRI Standard 540 10-coefficient compressor map [92] with the suction superheat correction by Dabiri & Rice [59].
